validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: independently confirmed real and operating -- offshore-technology.com/GlobalData profiles it as a 2,200km onshore Gazprom pipeline from Yamalo-Nenets AO to Tver Oblast, commissioned 2006; Gazprom PJSC's own archived corporate page (web.archive.org 2019 capture of gazprom.com/projects/srto-torzhok) independently corroborates 2,200km length, 1995 construction start, 2006 linear-part commissioning, design capacity 20.5-28.5 bcm/y (matches recorded 28.5); ru.wikipedia's Хулимсунт article and the Wayback capture of ukhta-tr.gazprom.ru's Vuktylskoe LPUMG page (2025-05-15) both independently name 'СРТО — Торжок' as a line actively operated within the Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta system, and live PAO Gazprom capital-repair tenders (rostender.info) for named km-markers on this line confirm ongoing active maintenance. CLASSIFICATION: transmission is correct -- this is one of the core Nadym-Pur-Taz export trunklines, not a gathering/feeder line. DUPLICATE: checked against the 30-row roster; no other row names 'SRTO-Torzhok' or 'Northern Tyumen Regions' -- distinct from the separate Ukhta-Torzhok (Yamal) lines (not in this roster) and from P2440 Urengoy-Chelyabinsk / P5414 Komsomolskoye-Surgut-Chelyabinsk (different corridor, addressed on those rows). ATTRIBUTION: Owner/operator Gazprom PJSC 100% confirmed (see Owner fill). SPEC: recorded Length 2,200km and Capacity 28.5 bcm/y both match Gazprom's own project page exactly. Diameter 1420mm matches offshore-technology's 'maximum diameter 56 inches' (=1422mm) within rounding, though a live capital-repair tender documents a DN1400 (not 1420) 18km segment near Sosnogorsk -- a plausible sectional variance on a line built/looped 1995-2012, not a contradiction of the recorded maximum-diameter figure. No material issues found; caveat only.
